entities.summary: Ernst Carl Friedrich te Peerdt was a German painter, associated with the Düsseldorfer Malerschule and the Münchner Schule. Ernst te Peerdt was a poets & playwrights from Tecklenburg (1852-11-25, Tecklenburg–1932-02-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Its legacy: Contributed poetry and drama to cultural canon.
